## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if any). List any dependencies required for this change.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Hardware & Environment Tested
- [ ] Tested on physical Android device (Model: ____________, Android version: ____)
- [ ] Tested ROS 2 communication with remote PC (`source_pc.sh` / `ros2 topic list`)
- [ ] Verified build succeeds: `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest`

## Checklist
